A media organization that reports on sports news and events.

An official who presides over a football match to ensure fair play and adherence to the rules.
A distinct territorial entity, usually a nation, with its own government.
The head of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).
A period of 365 or 366 days, typically from January 1 to December 31.
An organized group of football players, typically competing in a league or tournament.
A prize or recognition given in the sport of football for achievement or performance.
A large open-air venue used for sporting events or concerts.
One of the twelve periods of time into which a year is divided.
A specific point or duration within a sports match.
A temporal expression that refers to a time relative to another event or the present moment.

The numerical tally of points or goals achieved by competitors in a game or match.
A group of players forming a side in a football match or competition.
An inquiry or examination into whether a party has received preferential or advantageous treatment.
An event where one team wins a sports match against another.
A formal statement claiming unfair prejudice or favoritism.
A statement asserting that someone has been treated unjustly or inequitably.
A formal demand or petition for the dismissal or disqualification of officials.

A series of rulings or judgments made by officials that benefit one party.

An event where a player successfully puts the ball into the opponent's goal.
